intent: Reveal a short supplementary hint for a control on hover or focus, without adding it to the tab order.
avoid_when: the content is essential to complete the task; tooltips aren't reliably reachable on touch, so put essential info in visible text instead
the content is longer than a short phrase (use a popover or dialog)
a11y_contract: built on React Aria Tooltip/TooltipTrigger: shows on hover and keyboard focus of the trigger and is associated with it via `aria-describedby` automatically
requires_data: a focusable/hoverable trigger element and short hint text
